description: Draws one melodic line against the harmony on the cable — a bass, a melody or an inner voice. Place it beside mpxMelody, and another beside that for each further line

params.text: Steps against leaps: high keeps the line moving by step, low lets it jump
Chord tones against passing notes: high lands on the chord, low floats over it
The note the line is centred on, C1 to C7. Click for the list, or step it a semitone at a time with the wheel
How wide a register the line may move in, 7 to 36 semitones, centred on the note above
Note lengths: centre keeps what the rhythm sent, left shortens, right holds and slurs into legato
Note levels: centre keeps what the rhythm sent, left evens them, right leans on strong beats and chord tones
Pull toward the next chord as the change approaches. Set it high for a bass walking to the next root
The palette the line draws from, over the chart's key. From chord: the chord's tones, and key notes neither a semitone from one nor a tritone from its root. Click for the list
How long the line rests at the end of a phrase, in beats, for a rhythm that does not phrase. A rhythm from mpxPhrase already breathes and is left alone
How much a note sounding at a chord change is ended there. Nought holds what can musically be held. The held last note of a line is always kept unless it clashes
Which line this is, and so where it falls in the drawing order: bass first, then melody, then inner
How often the line stays on the note it is on. Low for a jazz line, which repeats about one note in twenty; higher for a song melody
When the rhythm restates an earlier figure, how surely the line brings back its pitches too. Where a pitch no longer fits the chord, the same step or the same direction is taken instead
How hard each breath group is pulled into the shape of a sung line: rising to its high point a quarter of the way through, then falling to end a little below where it began

inputs.text: Takes notes with a level and a duration and no pitch, from mpxEuclid or any MPX source
Picks the note from the weighted candidates, 0 to 10V. Unpatched, the seed and beat on the cable stand in
Moves the register centre while the line plays, ±5V over half the span. An arch over a phrase, or a slow climb

outputs.text: Carries this line on as an MPX stream

notes: place it immediately to the right of mpxMelody, or of another mpxVoice that is itself attached. The LINKED lamp is lit while something is driving it.
nothing is guessed at. An expander dragged away from its module goes silent rather than looking for another one across the rack.
the harmony, the separation and the random seed all come from the mpxMelody beside it, so none of them is on this panel.
the drawing order is bass, then melody, then inner, whatever order the expanders are placed in. Whichever draws first is the least constrained.
presets Pop 1 to 3 and Jazz 1 to 3 in the right-click menu set a melody line to go with mpxPhrase's presets of the same names.
